To solve eventual problem in visual Studio when compiling:
msbuild AAASeed_Maa.vcxproj /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug_v143 /p:Platform=x64 /v:diag > build.log
-----

Solution found when toolset v145 did not function on Insiders 2026:
<PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug_v145|x64'">
  <EnableStdModules>false</EnableStdModules>
</PropertyGroup>
infact we added <EnableStdModules>false</EnableStdModules> to each PropertyGroup of a v145 configuration
-----

These are the defines we used to compile AAASeed
/D "_VC80_UPGRADE=0x0710"
/D "GLM_FORCE_XYZW_ONLY"
/D "DEBUG" /D "_DEBUG"
/D "WIN32"
/D "AAASEED"
/D "AAA_TRACKER_PRIVATE=1"
/D "AAA_NEW_DESIGN_PRIVATE=1"
/D "VC_EXTRALEAN"
/D "_USE_MATH_DEFINES"
/D "NOMINMAX" /D "MSA_HOST_AAASEED=1" /D "DPSAPI_VERSION=1"
/D "UNICODE" /D "_UNICODE"
/D "GLEW_STATIC" /D "POCO_STATIC" /D "POCO_NO_AUTOMATIC_LIBS"
/D "XML_NS" /D "XML_DTD" /D "HAVE_EXPAT_CONFIG_H" /D "XML_EXPORTS"
/D "Util_EXPORTS"
-----
